verdict.rationale: Maritime's docs say any Docker image that implements a three-endpoint contract can run as an agent on the platform, and that any repo with a Dockerfile can be built and served. Templates are cloneable agent packages that publishers can share, which covers custom templates. missing for 10: detailed documentation on authoring and publishing custom templates, specifics of the three-endpoint contract and image constraints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define custom sandbox templates or bring my own container image

citations.quote: any Docker image that speaks a three-endpoint contract gets the whole platform
Any Docker container becomes an agent: three endpoints get you sleep/wake, channels, and triggers.
Any repo with a Dockerfile can be served on a public, no-login HTTPS URL. Maritime builds it, runs it serverlessly
Templates are cloneable agent packages; publishers can share them via link or the public library.
